name: Metal Container Corporation - Jacksonville FL Can Plant

fieldNotes.location: ROSTER ADDRESS CORRECTED. The roster's address (5775 Skinner Lake Dr) and coords (30.2524,-81.5380) were WRONG - that location is a commercial/retail area in SE Jacksonville. The actual MCC Jacksonville can plant is at 1100 Ellis Rd N, West Jacksonville FL 32254 (EPA TRI facility 32205MTLCN1100N; confirmed via Yelp, Jax Daily Record). Locked center on the MCC manufacturing complex at 30.33980,-81.74480. Note: this plant is in WEST Jacksonville, NOT adjacent to the AB Jacksonville brewery (which is on the city's far north side at Busch Dr) - the roster's 'adjacent to brewery' note is incorrect.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Large fully-fenced industrial plant - continuous chain-link perimeter fence confirmed all around the building and trailer yard in Street View (2025). A controlled vehicular entrance with divided entry/exit and directional arrow markings on the SE side; a gate spans the truck lane. Controlled truck gate - true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly identifiable guard booth at the truck gate; a small structure near the entrance at z21 is ambiguous. Classified false (kiosk/remote check-in implied) but flagged uncertain - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true because there IS a controlled truck gate but no positively-confirmed guard booth - implies kiosk/call-box/app check-in. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short approach from the SE gate to the trailer yard / dock aprons.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed in along the NW and W building faces; ~35 estimated, 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large marked-stall trailer drop yard on the W side of the building (yellow stall markings) holding ~110 trailers; 50+ band, capacity ~180. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on separate building faces (NW vs W).
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the W edge with covered hopper cars (aluminum coil/feedstock delivery) staged on sidings - clearly rail-served.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single large can-manufacturing building plus a small yard maintenance/dock structure - one primary building cluster, not a campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense West Jacksonville industrial district within the Jacksonville metro - Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified - flagged uncertain.
